title: Rubio urges Lebanon to resist Hezbollah pressure over seized explosives
description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio pressed Lebanon President Joseph Aoun not to return to Hezbollah a truck full of explosives it attempted to smuggle into Beirut several days ago, according to a State Department official and another source with knowledge of the call. title: Ukrainian officials blame Pentagon for withholding life-saving intel from Kyiv
description: The U.S. appears to have stopped sharing some forms of key intelligence with Kyiv, Ukrainian officials said Wednesday.

title: France and Germany agree to ease EU car emissions rules in new deal
description: France and Germany have backed looser EU emissions rules for carmakers and agreed to include Britain in a “made in Europe” scheme, in a provisional deal reached Thursday that could reshape the bloc’s automotive and climate policies.

title: Zelensky rallies European allies as US support for Ukraine wanes
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky sought European backing Thursday after vowing to resume strikes on Russian oil refineries despite US President Donald Trump’s demands, as tensions with Washington escalated over sanctions, energy infrastructure attacks and restrictions on satellite communications.

title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says
description: Yemen's information minister says the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt when ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace.

title: Israel halts commercial goods from entering Gaza; Hamas denies tax claims
description: The halt to commercial shipments, including fruit and winter clothing, cuts off a key source of critical supplies.

description: The Ukrainian president’s defiant decision to continue attacking Russian refineries underscores President Trump’s inability to end a war he had promised to resolve.

title: Houthi Missiles Strike Government Headquarters in Yemen
description: Five people were killed when the Houthi militia struck the Maashiq Palace in Aden, a Yemeni minister said.

description: BAGHDAD: Iraq’s parliament on Thursday approved the remainder of Prime Minister Ali Al-Zaidi’s cabinet, completing the formation of a government that took office five months ago with several key positions, lawmakers said. title: Japan’s foreign minister condemns deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
description: Japan's Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi expressed condolences to Saudi Arabia for the Houthi attacks that killed at least 12 people and injured over 300, calling such violence against civilians intolerable. He urged both the Houthis and Iran to exercise restraint and discussed enhancing coordination to stabilize critical shipping routes.

description: LONDON: An expanded regime of human rights-related sanctions came into force in the UK on Thursday, which grants the government wider powers to take action in response to the expansion of illegal Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territory.
